item.title: Self-Hosted GRC Platforms: SimpleRisk vs MONARC vs Eramba — Open Source Governance, Risk & Compliance 2026
item.description: Managing governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) is a critical function for organizations of all sizes. From ISO 27001 certification to GDPR compliance, having a structured platform to track risks, manage controls, and document compliance activities streamlines audits and reduces exposure. While enterprise GRC suites like RSA Archer and ServiceNow GRC command six-figure price tags, the open-source ecosystem offers capable self-hosted alternatives that put you in control of your compliance data.
